what_the_review_approves_correctly.summary: This rejection is about the manifest only. Nothing upstream of it is disputed.
what_the_review_approves_correctly.registration_repair_landed: REV-GUP-PKT-SD-015-015-stats-and-stat-modifiers-r05-r02 carries ten executable node_registry_decisions, supersedes r05-r01, and resolves the missing-registration defect the Integrator reported earlier. The Integrator reads all ten registrations without difficulty.
what_the_review_approves_correctly.bundle_lineage_is_valid: r05-r04 is the active Approved leaf, declares revision 4 and supersedes r05-r03, and names the active Review leaf r05-r02. Every declared checksum matches the bytes on disk: Review, GUP, edge component, and validation report.
what_the_review_approves_correctly.gup_is_already_correct: GUP-PKT-SD-015-015-stats-and-stat-modifiers-r05 classifies this exactly right. Its edges.csv holds 0 rows and its pending.csv holds 14; its operation index records additions: [] and fourteen pending_additions, and its summary records edge_additions: 0, edge_pending_additions: 14, node_additions_proposed: 10. The GUP even states the reason: these rows violate invariant 1 until the node is registered, so they are held out of the additions set.

defect_attribution.defect: The Approved manifest declares no operation_index. WORK_QUEUES legacy inference then reads every CSV row as an ordinary addition, which contradicts the reviewed GUP's own classification and trips the precondition that an addition may not depend on a node the same batch registers.
not_a_defect_in: the reviewed GUP, whose classification is correct as published
the approving Review, whose registrations are complete and executable
the edge component, whose 14 rows and checksum are exactly as declared
the Integrator tooling, whose genesis support was independently approved in REV-IMP-DEC-2026-0092-r01-r01
defect_attribution.why_this_is_a_genesis_characteristic: Shadowdark has no canonical state, so nothing was registered before this batch and every row necessarily depends on an identity the batch itself registers. A genesis manifest therefore carries an empty additions list and classifies every row as pending. This was recorded in advance as OBS-3 of IMP-DEC-2026-0092-r01 so it would not be read as a new rule when it appeared.

remediation.action: Publish a successor Approved manifest, APPROVED-GUP-PKT-SD-015-015-stats-and-stat-modifiers-r05-r05, that supersedes r05-r04, keeps approves, components and checksums byte-identical, and adds the operation_index the reviewed GUP already contains: additions: [] and pending_additions listing csv_row 1 through 14. Declaring node_operations.count: 10 is optional; if present it must equal the ten registrations the Review approves.
remediation.verification_the_integrator_will_repeat: Every declared checksum against disk, active-leaf status of both Review and bundle, then a dry run that must report fourteen additions classified as pending and zero blocking failures before any canonical file is created.

canonical_state.statement: No canonical file was created, modified, or removed. rulesets/shadowdark/canonical does not exist. The rejection was decided from bundle preconditions, before the transaction boundary and before any write.

governing_decisions.role: authorizes genesis initialization once independently verified, and requires the first ordinary transaction to select only a current checksum-valid Approved bundle
